title: UI Branch Version
description: Read-only: a numbered state of a UI branch, recorded by the server on every change to the branch's own items.

rbac_context.description: The branch's context: grants there decide who may read the version.

number.description: The version's number: 1 for the branch's first, then each one more than the last.

items.description: The branch's own items (its overrides, deletion markers included) by kind (component, stylesheet), each the item's content.

ancestors.description: The branching point: the version of every ancestor the branch was resolved against.
